                "headline": "Flood Warning issued November 14 at 10:14AM EST by NWS Melbourne FL",
                "description": "...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Florida...\n\nSt Johns River Near Astor affecting Volusia and Lake Counties.\n\n.On the St Johns River at Astor, slight rises within Minor Flood\nStage are forecast this weekend into next week due to a combination\nof northerly winds, downstream tidal effects, and water from upstream\nheavy rainfall working north through the basin.\n\nFor the St. Johns River...including Astor...Minor flooding is\nforecast.\n\n* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and moderate flooding is\nforecast.\n\n* WHERE...St Johns River near Astor.\n\n* WHEN...Until further notice.\n\n* IMPACTS...At 3.5 feet, Canals have overflowed into yards.                 "headline": "Flood Warning issued November 14 at 8:54AM CST until November 17 at 1:00AM CST by NWS Corpus Christi TX",
                "description": "...The Flood Warning is extended for the following rivers in Texas...\n\nNueces River Near Tilden affecting McMullen County.\n\nFor the Nueces River...including Tilden...Minor flooding is forecast.\n\n* WHAT...Minor flooding is forecast.\n\n* WHERE...Nueces River near Tilden.\n\n* WHEN...From this evening to late Monday night.\n\n* IMPACTS...At 15.0 feet, Much of the flood plain below cotulla to\nbelow tilden is cut off, as sloughs and peripheral channels fill.\nHunting cabins, oil field pump jacks and tank batteries flood well\naway from the channel.
